title: Second derivative of sqrt(det(I + t^2 S)) at 0 equals tr S
statement: For every natural number n and every real n x n matrix S, the function f(t) = sqrt(det(I_n + t^2 S)) (t in R) satisfies deriv (deriv f) 0 = trace S.
lean_statement: ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ S : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ, deriv (deriv (fun t : ℝ => Real.sqrt (Matrix.det ((1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + t ^ 2 • S)))) 0 = Matrix.trace S
